Recorded check: | Source (2.7) is false with (2.5); a specified allowed event has probability at most \(C n^{-1/5}\). | Opposite-sign centering changes the strip value by \(\alpha\log n+O(1)\).

Independent real N(0,1/n) entries; all Definition2.1 moment conditions. Choose alpha=1/4,r=1/2,epsilon=1/sqrt2−3/5>0. The strip is nonempty for all sufficiently large n.

Recorded check: Major. In Lemma 6.2(6.5), p. 28, the first logarithm in the integral of a deterministic Brownian variance is printed as \(\log(\eta_s/\eta_{S_1})\).

Real flow Xt=sqrt(1−T)Y+B_t/sqrt(n) with admissible real-GinibreY; z=i/2 in a fixed bulk disk. Fix sufficiently small0<c<1/4,eps1=eps2=c,T=n^-c,etaT=n^(-1+c),S1=0,s=S2=T; auxiliaryxi sufficiently small. The final eta condition holds with equality.
